newsitem.title: USA: U.S. FCC issues licenses for 'Big LEO' systems.
newsitem.headline: U.S. FCC issues licenses for 'Big LEO' systems.

text.p: The Federal Communications Commission on Monday issued licenses to Constellation Communications Inc and Mobile Communications Holdings Inc to construct and launch two satellite systems.
The systems will operate according to the rules governing the "Big LEO" service, the FCC said in a statement.
"Granting these licenses enhances the prospects for competition and consumer choice among offerings of global voice-and-data communications via handheld telephones," the statement said.
The systems can also offer services such as search and rescue communications, disaster manangement communications, industrial and environmental monitoring and paging services.
